state: A small team has one afternoon to fix a slow web app before a demo. The home page takes six seconds to load. A profiler shows that images account for most of the transfer size.

next_action.instructions: Choose the action most likely to improve the demo experience this afternoon.

criteria.Compress images: Resize and convert oversized images to a modern format.
criteria.Rewrite the backend: Replace the API framework and database layer.
criteria.Change the color palette: Update the site's colors without changing its load time.
